#include <iostream>
#include <cstdlib>
#include <cmath>
using namespace std;

static long long ONES[17] = {0};
void init_ones() {
    ONES[1] = 1;
    for (int i = 2; i < 17; i++) {
        ONES[i] = 10 * ONES[i-1] + 1;
    }
}

long long go(long long x, int len) {
    x = llabs(x);
    if (x % ONES[len] == 0) {
        return x / ONES[len] * len;
    }
    long long low = x / ONES[len];
    long long high = low + 1;

    long long ret1 = low * len + go(x - low * ONES[len], len - 1);
    long long ret2 = high * len + go(high * ONES[len] - x, len - 1);
    return min(ret1, ret2);
}

long long solve(long long x) {
    return go(x, 16);
}

int main() {
    init_ones();
    long long x;
    cin >> x;
    cout << solve(x) << endl;
    return 0;
}
